dedupe_keys.name: arcep fixed broadband deployments cartefibre fibre to the home roll out

description: This dataset publishes Arcep's observatory of fixed high-speed and very-high-speed broadband deployments, the data behind the Cartefibre map. It comes from the quarterly wholesale collection that infrastructure operators must answer under Arcep decisions 2018-0170 and 2023-0981, and gives the number of premises passed by fibre to the home and other very-high-speed technologies per commune and per technical zone, with the infrastructure operator, the type of zone (very dense, public initiative or private investment), deployment progress and, in later releases, the address-level list of connectable premises. Coverage: all of France, commune and sub-commune level, quarterly since 2016. Format and access: CSV, XLSX and compressed archives (about 170 resources totalling about 24 GB) on data.gouv.fr, with the map at cartefibre.arcep.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Caveats: figures are declared by operators; the address-level archives are very large; definitions changed when the 2023 decision came into force. Simulation uses: an asset inventory and planned-infrastructure series for broadband network planning, exposure of fibre networks to hazards, and tracking of the copper switch-off. Related records: Ma connexion internet gives availability by address, and the Arcep FTTH quality data give network faults.
